text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
While walking through town, I ran into 
Rice Shower and the others and chatted 
with them.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
We're on our way to buy materials for 
preserved flowers right now...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
The flowers bloomed so beautifully, so I'm 
really looking forward to making them...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Ah, hey hey, look over there! There's a 
bunch of people dressed up so pretty!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
You're right. Everyone is dressed up in 
kimonos and dresses... Could it be a 
wedding?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
A wedding...! How lovely, I'd love to see 
the ceremony...!

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
After all, showering rice is meant to 
bless the happy couple ...just like your 
name, "Rice Shower"!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: E-Ehehe... Oh, Rob Roy-san, you tease...!

text_block_list.name: Venue Staff
text_block_list.text:
What did you say?! The bouquet hasn't 
arrived?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The flustered voice of the venue staff 
rang out. It seemed a mishap prevented the 
bouquet from arriving, and attempts to 
arrange a replacement on short notice had 
fallen through.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A wedding without any flowers... How could 
this be...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
What should we do, it's Rice's fault... 
Because Rice was standing here, the 
wedding is ruined...!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, flowers, huh. They need a whole bunch 
of them, right?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Since it's a bouquet, a substantial amount 
is required... But to prepare that many so 
suddenly...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...No, Rice can bring some!

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Huh? Rice-chan?! Where are you going?!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: Haa... haa...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Um, ex-excuse me...! If you'd like, please 
take these flowers...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Rice Shower handed over the armful of 
flowers she was carrying to the wedding 
venue staff.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
Rice-san, those flowers are... Could they 
be...
choice_data_list: Weren't those meant for preserved flowers?
Aren't those for making preserved flowers?

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
It's fine, please use them! I'd hate for 
the wedding to stay unhappy like this...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
If Rice's flowers can make someone happy, 
nothing would make me happier...!

text_block_list.name: Venue Staff
text_block_list.text:
...! With this, we can hold the wedding as 
planned!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The wedding was able to proceed smoothly. 
Rice Shower and the others were invited to 
the ceremony as guests of honor.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: It's finally time for the bouquet toss...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Waaah, somehow Rice is the one getting 
nervous...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The bouquet filled with blessings was 
thrown. It soared high up into the sky, 
and—

text_block_list.name: Crow
text_block_list.text: Caw, caw... *Snatch!*

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text: Wah~! Mr. Crow got the bouquet!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Wh-What should we do...! Is it because, 
because Rice was here...!?

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yup! It's totally 'cause Rice-chan is 
here! Look at the sky, it's super pretty!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: ...Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Flowers began raining down from the sky. 
The bouquet clutched in the crow's beak 
came undone, showering petals 
everywhere...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
A flower shower... What a truly fitting 
spectacle for a day like today.

text_block_list.name: Haru Urara
text_block_list.text:
Yay! Now everyone gets to share the 
happiness!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...Ah! Thank goodness... I finally managed 
to make everyone smile...!

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
...May everyone, always and forever, be 
filled with happiness.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
...And so, the flowers of happiness 
brought smiles to the people ever after. 
And they all lived happily ever after, 
didn't they?
